key_insight: AtomSteer adds chemical and crystallographic constraint control to pretrained atomistic generative models at inference time, without retraining or architectural changes.
engineering_relevance: It enables existing crystal, molecular conformer, and protein–ligand generators to better satisfy structural requirements while limiting disruption to generated geometry.
method: Correct intermediate predictions during sampling using bounded local projections.
Apply graph-rigid stereochemical transformations and periodic-symmetry projections.
Accept updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes elsewhere.
evidence_signal: Across FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, evaluations report improved crystal space-group coverage and recovery, molecular validity and E/Z accuracy, and reduced ligand E/Z errors with competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify inference overhead or improvement magnitudes, leaving practical cost–benefit trade-offs to be assessed.
paper_title: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
